put.description: Set the shared Account/Arena handle (3–24) and biography (160), and optional capital effective_from. 409 if any trade with closed_at >= effective_from was received already. Declare before import; no historical rebasing. Unknown fields are ignored; UTC ISO-8601 times; decimal values accept strings or JSON numbers. At most 64 KiB and 60 attempts/minute/key.

202.description: Recorded (200 when everything sent was already recorded unchanged). accepted counts inserted records; updated counts corrected trades; identical trade resends count neither.

400.description: All detected validation problems; the batch writes nothing.

401.description: A live user key is required; arena:write scoped keys permit trades/positions only.

409.description: capital_history_locked/capital_conflict on conflicting capital declarations; trade_locked: a trade first received more than 24 hours ago cannot be changed; the batch writes nothing. An identical resend is accepted.

post.description: Report one closed position or 1–100 positions, each marked account live or demo. Client trade IDs are account-scoped; an identical resend is a no-op (200); a correction updates the position and is kept as a revision only within 24 hours of its first receipt, after which a changed resend is refused with 409 trade_locked. Unknown fields are ignored; UTC ISO-8601 times; decimal values accept strings or JSON numbers. At most 64 KiB and 60 attempts/minute/key.

post.description: Replace the current open positions snapshot of one account type (live or demo, required). An empty positions array clears that type's snapshot. At most 64 KiB and 60 attempts/minute/key.

fill_id.description: Venue fill ID, retained with the reported fill; not independent evidence of execution.
